end.parentNote: Asha practised reading ordered pairs by moving first along the x-axis, then along the y-axis. Harsh correctly used coordinate signs to identify Quadrant II and explained the origin and axes crossing. They mixed up (3, 2) and (2, 3) again at the end; this was corrected earlier in the lesson but was not secure after the last occurrence. At home, practise plotting several swapped pairs such as (2, 3) and (3, 2), saying each movement aloud.
